# `auth/session.ts`

Module for managing user session data. Provides the core session data structure used throughout the authentication system.

---

## Interfaces

### `SessionData`

Represents the data stored in a user session.

```typescript
interface SessionData {
  user: {
    id: number;
    entraOid: string;
    email: string;
    displayName: string;
    role: string;
  };
}
```

#### Members

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `user` | `object` | The authenticated user's session information |
| `user.id` | `number` | The user's unique numeric identifier |
| `user.entraOid` | `string` | The user's Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) Object ID |
| `user.email` | `string` | The user's email address |
| `user.displayName` | `string` | The user's display name |
| `user.role` | `string` | The user's assigned role |

#### Example

```typescript
const session: SessionData = {
  user: {
    id: 42,
    entraOid: "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx",
    email: "user@example.com",
    displayName: "Jane Doe",
    role: "admin",
  },
};
```
